rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 安倍内閣総辞職, dated 16 September 2020, says that the Abe cabinet resigned en masse that day: at that day's cabinet meeting the resignation en masse was decided, after which the Prime Minister's statement on the resignation was issued.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account says that 安倍総理 left the Prime Minister's Office, seen off by the staff; its photograph caption reads 職員から花束を贈呈される安倍総理.
